items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I’m Paul. I’m building Syd, an offline-first forensic workstation that orchestrates tools like YARA and Nmap through a GUI, using a local LLM to analyze the results without leaking data. It runs completely offline on localhost—no data is ever sent to the cloud, making it safe for sensitive investigations. Here's a demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dQV3JbLrRE . AI is great at explaining malware signatures, but I couldn't use ChatGPT for my work because pasting potential malware or sensitive logs into a web form is a massive security risk. I needed the intelligence of an LLM but with the privacy of an air-gapped machine. Under the hood, it’s built on Python 3. I use subpr

items.title: Are others seeing early-stage funding shift from AI apps to infrastructure?
items.raw_excerpt:
I’ve been tracking early-stage funding and founder movement across AI, deep-tech, and infra for several months, and a pattern keeps repeating: Capital is quietly rotating from apps → infra. Not the hype-cycle rotation — the real, structural one. Signals I’m repeatedly seeing:
• inference infra growing • retrieval pipelines getting funded • data systems / cyber infra cooling less • apps (especially wrappers) slowing • founders moving to deeper layers What’s interesting is that this shift isn’t loud. It’s forming underneath the narrative, not above it. My question to the HN community: Are you seeing similar signals — in your teams, companies, investment decisions, or founder circles? Not promoting anything — just exploring the signal.

title_i18n.en: Are others seeing early-stage funding shift from AI apps to infrastructure?
title_i18n.zh: 其他人是否注意到早期投资正从人工智能应用转向基础设施领域？
title_i18n.es: ¿Están observando otros un cambio en la financiación inicial de las aplicaciones de IA hacia la infraestructura?

excerpt_i18n.en:
I’ve been tracking early-stage funding and founder movement across AI, deep-tech, and infra for several months, and a pattern keeps repeating: Capital is quietly rotating from apps → infra. Not the hype-cycle rotation — the real, structural one. Signals I’m repeatedly seeing:

items.title: Show HN: WishDrop – AI-built gift coordination app (Claude Code, Nano Banana)
items.raw_excerpt:
My family kept running into the same problem every year:
How do you share a long list of gift ideas with multiple people — without ending up with duplicates? This weekend I decided to fix it — and benchmark the new wave of AI coding assistants at the same time:
Claude Code, Claude Code Web, Google Antigravity, and OpenAI Codex, with visuals from Google Nano Banana and ChatGPT. Claude Code Web was by far the best autonomous agent — it planned, iterated, and wrote tests almost like a cofounder. I even ran five sessions in parallel from my phone until I hit the session cap. The result: WishDrop.io A small app that helps families and friends coordinate gifts without duplicates.
No login, instant sharing, real-time reservations.
Even the name (and domain check!) came from AI. Built with Next.js

Leifeng News: The opening ceremony of the 2025 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Scientists (ICAIS 2025) and the release of achievements in intelligent science systems from the Zhongguancun Two Institutes were grandly held in Beijing. Co-hosted by Beijing Zhongguancun College and Zhongguancun Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, in collaboration with Tsinghua University and Westlake University, and co-organized by the University of Chicago, this conference is the world's first benchmark event focusing on "AI-driven scientific research innovation." It brought together experts from multidisciplinary fields, including Chinese and foreign academicians and top scholars, to explore the evolution of artificial intelligence from a research aid to an "intelligent research partner." Carbon-silicon synergy is developing from the dream of generations of scientists into a core engine and key pathway for global technological innovation.

Attendees included Xu Qingsen, member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice Minister of Education; Mu Peng, member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice Mayor of Beijing Municipal Government; Li Yi, Deputy Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Education Working Committee and Director of the Municipal Education Commission; Yang Pu, Deputy Director of the Beijing Municipal Science and Technology Commission and Deputy Director of the Municipal Talent Bureau; Zhang Ge, Secretary of the Haidian District Committee; and Tang Chao, Deputy Director of the Zhongguancun Science City Management Committee and Deputy District Head of Haidian District. Wu Huaqiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee and Vice President of Tsinghua University, and Zhang Yaqin, foreign academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering and Dean of the Institute for AI Industry Research at Tsinghua University, attended the event and delivered speeches. Liu Tieyan, President of Beijing Zhongguancun College, served as the conference chair and gave the welcome address.

The conference also gathered top global scientific figures, including Serge Haroche, 2012 Nobel Laureate in Physics; Thomas J. Sargent, 2011 Nobel Laureate in Economics; and the 2013 Nobel Laureate.

items.title: 沈向洋：五个维度思考智能演进 机会不仅来自技术本身
items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网消息，在2025 IDEA大会上，IDEA研究院创院理事长、美国国家工程院外籍院士沈向洋用五个维度梳理了智能演进的脉络：算法范式、智能载体、交互范式、计算架构与数据。  他表示，相比给出一个技术路径路线图，他更希望提出一个“识别机会”的思考框架，帮助创新者在智能演进中找到技术、产品与商业的切口。 算法范式维度：从模式学习走向目标驱动 AI 的算法演进的三个阶段：监督学习构筑表达与生成能力，强化学习引入因果与执行，自主学习迈向高层认知。技术本身从 Transformer 架构出发，向更高效、更稳健的体系演化；从自回归到扩散，再到混合式生成方法，这些变化共同推动智能的表达边界不断拓展。 智能载体维度：从符号空间走向物理空间 业界关注点已从语言和多模态模型转向世界模型与具身模型。这一变化反映出智能载体正从抽象符号空间迈向物理空间，“从理解世界，到改变世界”。世界模型理解物理规律与因果，具身模型则把感知、决策与行动闭环联通，使 AI 成为能在现实环境中施加影响的主体。 交互范式维度：技术与人的关系被改写 在人机交互维度上，沈向洋强调交互创新的重要性。过去 70 年，人机交互经历了命令行、图形界面、搜索、推荐到自然交互的多次范式迁移；每一次迁移背后，都对应着底层技术浪潮的变化。“今天的产品开发者必须看懂智能特性带来的交互机会。”他同时指出，自然交互内部也在分层：从被动响应，到交互式执行，再到具备提议能力的主动模式，交互方式从文本扩展到语音、手势乃至未来的脑机接口。 计算架构维度：性能、成本与能效的新平衡点 趋势是从通用走向专用、从单一走向多元。GPU刺激了深度学习的第一波爆发，但能耗与成本也不断攀升。随着应用多样化，推理、端侧、强化学习等专用芯片不断涌现；未来光子、量子、类脑等也可能在特定领域带来性能跃升。 数据维度：从静态教材、动态反馈到证据 在智能演

excerpt_i18n.en: According to Leiphone, at the 2025 IDEA Conference, Harry Shum, founding chairman of the IDEA Institute and foreign member of the U.S. National Academy of Engineering, outlined the trajectory of intelligent evolution across five dimensions: algorithmic paradigms, intelligent agents, interaction paradigms, computing architectures, and data. He expressed that rather than providing a technical roadmap, he aims to offer a thinking framework for "identifying opportunities" to help innovators find entry points for technology, products, and business in the evolution of intelligence. In the algorithmic paradigms dimension, AI has progressed from pattern learning to goal-driven approaches through three stages: supervised learning builds expression and generation capabilities, reinforcement learning introduces causality and execution, and autonomous learning advances toward higher-level cognition. Technologically, starting from the Transformer architecture, it evolves toward more efficient and robust systems, moving from autoregressive to diffusion and hybrid generation methods, collectively expanding the boundaries of intelligent expression. In the intelligent agents dimension, the industry's focus has shifted from language and multimodal models to world models and embodied models, reflecting a transition from abstract symbolic spaces to physical spaces—from understanding the world to changing it. World models comprehend physical laws and causality, while embodied models integrate perception, decision-making, and action into a closed loop, enabling AI to act as an agent that influences real-world environments. In the interaction paradigms dimension, the relationship between technology and humans is being redefined. Over the past 70 years, Harry Shum emphasized the importance of interaction innovation.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según Leifeng, en la conferencia IDEA 2025, Shen Xiangyang, presidente fundador del Instituto IDEA y miembro extranjero de la Academia Nacional de Ingeniería de EE. UU., delineó la evolución de la inteligencia en cinco dimensiones: paradigma algorítmico, soporte de inteligencia, paradigma de interacción, arquitectura computacional y datos. Enfatizó que, en lugar de ofrecer una hoja de ruta tecnológica, busca proponer un marco de pensamiento para "identificar oportunidades" que ayude a los innovadores a encontrar puntos de entrada tecnológicos, de producto y comerciales en la evolución inteligente. Dimensión del paradigma algorítmico: de aprendizaje por patrones a IA impulsada por objetivos, con tres etapas en la evolución algorítmica: el aprendizaje supervisado construye capacidades de expresión y generación, y el aprendizaje por refuerzo introduce causalidad.

title_i18n.es: Muestrear y Mapear desde un Potencial Convexo Único: Generación mediante Medidas Conjugadas de Momentos

excerpt_i18n.en: The canonical approach in generative modeling is to split model fitting into two blocks: define first how to sample noise (e.g. Gaussian) and choose next what to do with it (e.g. using a single map or flows). We explore in this work an alternative route that ties sampling and mapping. We find inspiration in moment measures, a result that states that for any measure ρ, there exists a unique convex potential u such that ρ = ∇u♯e-u.
